# Superconductivity Found in Meteorites: MFMMS dataset (third-party data)

- **File:** `bb24282657_1_1.tar` (42536960 bytes, sha256 `7724abc2f9f2a7fa1ec7331b49edf9b1190ae27cde169ceff36f7336651ed048`)
- **Added by:** the repository owner in commit a991b46 (2026-10-30), originally at
  `AI Agent Audits/evidence/Data from Superconductivity Found in Meteorites/`.
- **Moved here** in integration/round5 because `AI Agent Audits/evidence/` is sealed by the
  hash-pinned `audit_manifest.json`; an unlisted file there makes `verify_manifest.py` fail.
  The file's bytes are unchanged.
- **What it is:** a tar of the folder `MFMMS/`: MFMMS measurements of samples from 15 meteorites
  (.txt tab-separated data, .dsc descriptor files, .dta/.xgf machine files), with `MFMMS/README.txt`
  describing the naming conventions. Upstream title, per the original folder name:
  "Data from Superconductivity Found in Meteorites".
- **Status:** unverified third-party input. Not used by any AIEF claim yet. Source URL and licence
  are to be recorded by the owner before any claim relies on it. Do not extract it at the repo root.
